checks.name: CK_Asset_BulkNotHeld
checks.expression: ([IsBulk] = 0 OR ([CurrentEmployeeId] IS NULL AND [CurrentLocationId] IS NULL))

checks.name: CK_AssetPurchaseDetail_WarrantyWindow
checks.expression: ([WarrantyEndDate] IS NULL OR [WarrantyStartDate] IS NULL OR [WarrantyEndDate] >= [WarrantyStartDate])

checks.name: CK_CustomFieldDefinition_Type
checks.expression: ([FieldType] IN (N'Text', N'Number', N'Percentage', N'Date', N'Boolean', N'Dropdown'))

checks.name: CK_CustomFieldDefinition_Range
checks.expression: ([MinValue] IS NULL OR [MaxValue] IS NULL OR [MaxValue] >= [MinValue])

checks.name: CK_AssetFinance_Method
checks.expression: ([DepreciationMethod] IS NULL OR [DepreciationMethod] IN (N'StraightLine', N'WrittenDownValue', N'None'))

checks.name: CK_AssetHolding_OnePlaceKind
checks.expression: (([LocationId] IS NOT NULL AND [CustomerSiteId] IS NULL) OR ([LocationId] IS NULL AND [CustomerSiteId] IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: CK_AssetInstrumentDetail_Window
checks.expression: ([CalibrationEndDate] IS NULL OR [CalibrationStartDate] IS NULL OR [CalibrationEndDate] >= [CalibrationStartDate])

checks.name: CK_AssetHandover_ReceiptPair
checks.expression: (([IsReceivedByHo] = 0 AND [ReceivedAtHoOnUtc] IS NULL) OR ([IsReceivedByHo] = 1 AND [ReceivedAtHoOnUtc] IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: CK_AssetHandover_CancelPair
checks.expression: (([Status] = N'Cancelled' AND [CancelledOnUtc] IS NOT NULL) OR ([Status] <> N'Cancelled' AND [CancelledOnUtc] IS NULL))

checks.name: CK_AssetMovement_ReceiptPair
checks.expression: (([Status] = N'Received' AND [ReceivedOnUtc] IS NOT NULL) OR ([Status] <> N'Received' AND [ReceivedOnUtc] IS NULL))

checks.name: CK_AssetTransferRequest_TypePair
checks.expression:
(([TransferType] = 'Employee'   AND [ToEmployeeId]   IS NOT NULL) OR
([TransferType] = 'Department' AND [ToDepartmentId] IS NOT NULL) OR
([TransferType] = 'Branch'     AND [ToLocationId]   IS NOT NULL) OR
([TransferType] = 'CostCenter' AND [ToCostCenter]   IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: CK_ServiceRequest_SlaMinutes
checks.expression: ([ResolutionConsumedMinutes] >= 0 AND [TechnicianWorkingMinutes] >= 0 AND [SlaPausedMinutes] >= 0 AND ([ResponseElapsedMinutes] IS NULL OR [ResponseElapsedMinutes] >= 0))

checks.name: CK_RequestHistory_EntryKind
checks.expression: ([EntryKind] IN (N'Transition', N'Note', N'Email', N'Automation', N'Sla', N'Escalation'))

checks.name: CK_LocationOperationalHour_BreakPair
checks.expression: (([BreakStartTime] IS NULL AND [BreakEndTime] IS NULL) OR ([BreakStartTime] IS NOT NULL AND [BreakEndTime] IS NOT NULL AND [BreakEndTime] > [BreakStartTime]))

checks.name: CK_LocationOperationalDay_CustomTimes
checks.expression: ([DayType] <> N'Custom' OR ([StartTime] IS NOT NULL AND [EndTime] IS NOT NULL AND [EndTime] > [StartTime]))

checks.name: CK_LocationOperationalDay_CustomBreak
checks.expression: (([BreakStartTime] IS NULL AND [BreakEndTime] IS NULL) OR ([BreakStartTime] IS NOT NULL AND [BreakEndTime] IS NOT NULL AND [BreakEndTime] > [BreakStartTime]))

checks.name: CK_HolidayCalendar_Recurrence
checks.expression: ([IsRecurringAnnually] = 0 OR ([RecurrenceMonth] BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND [RecurrenceDay] >= 1 AND [RecurrenceDay] <= CASE WHEN [RecurrenceMonth] IN (4, 6, 9, 11) THEN 30 WHEN [RecurrenceMonth] = 2 THEN 29 ELSE 31 END))

checks.name: CK_ApprovalWorkflowDefinition_Priority
checks.expression: ([Priority] IS NULL OR [Priority] IN (N'Low', N'Medium', N'High', N'Critical'))

checks.name: CK_ApprovalWorkflowDefinition_EffectiveRange
checks.expression: ([EffectiveToUtc] IS NULL OR [EffectiveFromUtc] IS NULL OR [EffectiveToUtc] > [EffectiveFromUtc])

checks.name: CK_ApprovalWorkflowStage_Timers
checks.expression:
(
            ([DueAfterMinutes] IS NULL OR [DueAfterMinutes] > 0) AND
            ([ReminderAfterMinutes] IS NULL OR [ReminderAfterMinutes] > 0) AND
            ([ReminderRepeatMinutes] IS NULL OR [ReminderRepeatMinutes] > 0) AND
            ([EscalateAfterMinutes] IS NULL OR [EscalateAfterMinutes] >= 0)
        )

checks.name: CK_ApprovalStageApproverRule_ResolverType
checks.expression:
([ResolverType] IN (
            N'User', N'Role', N'Capability', N'EmployeeManager', N'RequesterManager',
            N'LocationBranchAdmin', N'CustomEmail'
        ))

checks.name: CK_ApprovalStageApproverRule_Value
checks.expression:
(
            ([ResolverType] = N'User'                AND [ResolverUserId] IS NOT NULL) OR
            ([ResolverType] = N'Role'                AND [ResolverRoleId] IS NOT NULL) OR
            ([ResolverType] = N'Capability'          AND [ResolverCapabilityName] IS NOT NULL) OR
            ([ResolverType] = N'EmployeeManager') OR
            ([ResolverType] = N'RequesterManager') OR
            ([ResolverType] = N'LocationBranchAdmin' AND [ResolverCapabilityName] IS NOT NULL) OR
            ([ResolverType] = N'CustomEmail'         AND [ResolverEmail] IS NOT NULL)
        )

checks.name: CK_RequestApprovalStep_Status
checks.expression: ([Status] IN (N'Waiting', N'Pending', N'Approved', N'Rejected', N'Skipped', N'Cancelled'))

checks.name: CK_RequestApprovalStep_Activation
checks.expression: ([Status] IN (N'Waiting', N'Cancelled', N'Skipped') OR [ActivatedOnUtc] IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: CK_RequestApprovalParticipant_Identity
checks.expression: ([ApproverUserId] IS NOT NULL OR [ApproverEmployeeId] IS NOT NULL OR [ApproverEmailSnapshot] <> N'')

checks.name: CK_RequestApprovalParticipant_Status
checks.expression: ([ParticipantStatus] IN (N'Waiting', N'Pending', N'Approved', N'Rejected', N'Delegated', N'Cancelled'))

checks.name: CK_ApprovalNotificationLog_Type
checks.expression:
([NotificationType] IN (
            N'ApprovalRequired', N'Reminder', N'Escalation', N'StepApproved',
            N'RequestApproved', N'RequestRejected', N'RequestCancelled'
        ))
